title: Supervisors considering AI data center ban for unincorporated LA County
source_used: Los Angeles Daily News (pool link, fetched text)
key_facts: The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors will consider a proposal on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026 to develop a zoning amendment prohibiting large-scale data centers in unincorporated parts of the county.

The motion, by Supervisor Hilda Solis, would direct the Department of Regional Planning to draft the amendment, define types of data centers by acreage, square footage, energy use and water consumption, and ban 'large-scale' ones in every zone of unincorporated LA County.
It cites energy and water demand and potential public health effects; the board received 101 pages of public comments, mostly calling for a moratorium.

It points to Monterey Park, Montebello, Baldwin Park and El Monte, which have acted to restrict or halt data center development, and notes Alhambra voters are due to consider a similar ballot measure in November.
On 17 Sep 2026 the county's planning director used existing zoning authority to prohibit large-scale data centers while a full amendment is developed.

The motion would also ask Public Health and County Counsel whether noise rules should cover 'low frequency and continuous noise' from large data centers, and have staff ready to introduce a moratorium if a proposed project poses a 'current and immediate threat'.
quote_evidence: The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors will consider a proposal Tuesday to develop a zoning amendment prohibiting large-scale data centers in unincorporated parts of the county, citing concerns about the energy and water demands and potential public health effects associated with facilities used to power artificial intelligence.

The motion cites actions by Monterey Park, Montebello, Baldwin Park and El Monte to restrict or halt data center development and notes that Alhambra voters are scheduled to consider a similar ballot measure in November.
The item is scheduled to be considered when the Board of Supervisors meets Tuesday.
why_it_matters_hint: A very large US county is moving toward banning big AI data centers in its unincorporated areas, though Tuesday's step only starts the drafting.
event_date: Hearing scheduled for Tuesday 6 Oct 2026; the article is dated 5 Oct 2026.
notes: A proposal, not an action: the outcome of Tuesday's vote is not known. The 17 Sep planning-director prohibition and the April county study are background in the motion.
